name: l0_ai_sound_owner
about: FUN_101ad9a0 0x101ad9a0, the AI sound-event owner cache, and the one caller that reaches it: the toggle Use FUN_101ad470 0x101ad470, arm U4, inside the source-valid gate after the START emit (walks/L0-r006.md). PlaySound = Use(activator, caller, 1, 0), StopSound = Use(.., 0, 0). O1: the cached handle +0x4d8 is -1, stale or empty -> FindEntityByName(list, NULL, sound_event_owner, activator = this, caller = NULL), +0x4d8 <- the match's handle or -1; a valid cache skips the lookup. O2: a valid handle answers its entity, else NULL. U4: sound_event == 0 inserts nothing; a NULL owner with sound_event outside {0x20 CARCASS, 0x800 FLINCH} -> Warning('%s has invalid NPC sound event parameters'), no insert; sound_event_level outside [1, 3] -> Warning and clamp, written back; CSoundEnt::InsertSound(sound_event, the SOURCE entity's GetAbsOrigin (asm 0x101ad85a), VolumeLevels[level] (180 / 240 / 1200, sound_volume_table.txt), max(1.0, GetSoundDuration), 0, owner). A second PlaySound on an active looping ambient returns at U0 (ON while active) and never reaches U4; the owner is re-resolved only by a fresh start (StopSound then PlaySound).

expect.label: use_on
expect.match: fn=CAmbientGeneric::Use va=0x101ad470 phase=entry useType=1 value=0 m_fActive=0 m_fLooping=1

expect.label: start
expect.match: fn=CAmbientGeneric::Use va=0x101ad470 phase=emit flags=0x0 vol=1.00 level=70 pitch=100 origin=.* source=self

expect.label: owner_found
expect.match: fn=FUN_101ad9a0 va=0x101ad9a0 phase=return owner=owner_a via=lookup name=owner_a

expect.label: inserted
expect.match: fn=CAmbientGeneric::Use va=0x101ad470 phase=insert type=0x1 origin=.* source=self volume=240 level=2 duration=[0-9.]+ owner=owner_a

expect.label: stop
expect.match: fn=CAmbientGeneric::Use va=0x101ad470 phase=emit flags=0x4 vol=0.00 level=0 pitch=0

expect.label: carcass_inserted
expect.match: phase=insert type=0x20 origin=.* source=self volume=1200 level=3 duration=[0-9.]+ owner=null

notes: The ambients start silent (spawnflags 16) so the first PlaySound is the start that reaches U4; owner_a is a start-silent ambient standing in for any named entity. The insert's duration is the engine's GetSoundDuration floored at 1.0: in the headless host it is the floor, so the record matches any value.
